第69章 老宅那边眼红了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强脚步一顿。

“食品柜台？”

“嗯，年年亏损，工资都发不出。

供销社不想贴钱了，打算包出去。”

刘强点了根烟，“怎么，你有兴趣？”

林国强心里飞快盘算。

“有。”

刘强看了他一眼：“那行，我帮你约王主任。

不过丑话说前头，那柜台位置偏，以前卖点心饼干都卖不动。

你要接，得想好卖啥。”

林国强点头：“我想好了。”

三天后，林国强通过刘强引荐，见到了供销社的王主任。

王主任五十多岁，胖乎乎的，脸上总是带着笑，但眼睛里透着精明。

“林老板，你那小吃店我听说过，生意不错。”

王主任端着茶缸子，“不过咱这供销社的柜台，跟你那店不一样。

来往的人杂，要求也高。”

林国强从布包里掏出一叠纸。

“王主任，这是我的计划。”

王主任接过来，翻了翻，脸上的笑容渐渐收了起来。

纸上写得清清楚楚：

供货品种：卤猪蹄、卤豆干、卤鸡腿、卤蛋、凉拌小菜。

供货方式：每日上午十点、下午三点两次配送，保证新鲜。

利润分成：供销社拿三成，林国强拿七成。

水电、人员工资由供销社承担。

食品安全：如有质量问题，林国强承担全部责任。

“你这.……”王主任抬起头，“想得够细的。”

“做生意，想不细不行。”林国强说，“您放心，卤味这块，整个镇上我认第二，没人敢认第一。”

王主任沉吟了一会儿。

“利润分成，你七我们三，是不是……”

“王主任。”林国强打断他，“我出配方、出食材，出卤味，您出个柜台和售货员。

三成，是净赚的，您想想，以前那柜台卖点心，一个月赔多少钱？”

王主任不说话了。

“咱们先试一个月。”林国强说，“一个月后，您看账本。

行，继续，不行，我撤，柜台您再找别人。”

王主任盯着他看了好一会儿，忽然笑了。

“行，就按你说的办。”

签约、腾柜台、打扫卫生、做招牌。

三天时间，供销社食品柜台焕然一新。

Lin Guoqiang paused.

"Food counter?"

“Well, we’re losing money every year and we can’t even pay our wages.

The supply and marketing cooperative no longer wants to pay for it and plans to outsource it."

Liu Qiang lit a cigarette, "What, are you interested?"

Lin Guoqiang made quick calculations in his mind.

"Yes."

Liu Qiang glanced at him: "Okay, I'll help you make an appointment with Director Wang.

But to start with, the counter is located in a remote location, and I couldn’t even sell snacks and biscuits before.

If you want to take it, you have to think about what to sell."

Lin Guoqiang nodded: "I've thought about it."

Three days later, Lin Guoqiang met Director Wang of the supply and marketing cooperative through Liu Qiang's introduction.

Director Wang is in his fifties, chubby, and always has a smile on his face, but his eyes are shrewd.

"Boss Lin, I've heard about your snack bar and it's doing good business."

Director Wang held the teapot, "But the counter of our supply and marketing cooperative is different from your store.

There are many people coming and going, and the requirements are high."

Lin Guoqiang took out a stack of paper from his cloth bag.

"Director Wang, this is my plan."

Director Wang took it and turned it over, the smile on his face gradually faded away.

It is clearly written on the paper:

Supplied varieties: braised pig trotters, braised dried beans, braised chicken legs, braised eggs, and cold side dishes.

Supply method: Delivery twice daily at 10 am and 3 pm to ensure freshness.

Profit sharing: The supply and marketing cooperative gets 30%, and Lin Guoqiang gets 70%.

Water, electricity and personnel wages are borne by the supply and marketing cooperative.

Food safety: If there are quality problems, Lin Guoqiang takes full responsibility.

"You..." Director Wang raised his head, "Think carefully enough."

"When doing business, you have to think carefully." Lin Guoqiang said, "Don't worry, I'm the second best in the whole town when it comes to braised food, and no one dares to be the first."

Director Wang pondered for a while.

"Profit sharing, you seven and we three, right..."

"Director Wang." Lin Guoqiang interrupted him, "I will provide the formula, ingredients, and braised food, and you will provide the counter and salesperson.

Thirty percent is a net profit. Think about it, how much did that counter lose a month when selling snacks?"

Director Wang stopped talking.

"Let's try it for a month first." Lin Guoqiang said, "After one month, you can look at the ledger.

OK, continue, no, I'll withdraw and you can find someone else at the counter."

Director Wang stared at him for a while and suddenly smiled.

"Okay, I'll do as you say."

Signing contracts, clearing counters, cleaning, and making signs.

In three days, the food counter of the supply and marketing cooperative took on a new look.
